description: Fetches a public webpage (GET, 10 s timeout, 2 MB cap) together with its external stylesheets and @imports, and parses it into the same reference AST as ingest_html: role-classified sections with size_hint heights, palette, design tokens, self-hosted fonts (`font_groups`), computed typography, images, and — with detail:'full' — per-section blocks, lists and widgets. Absolute-canvas builder exports (LadiPage-family or Webcake-published pages) are detected and converted deterministically into a complete Webcake page `source` with `clone_notes` and `canvas_summary`. JavaScript is not executed, so client-rendered sites (React/Vue/Next.js) may return little content; the result then carries a warning that the body was empty. Fetches are restricted to public hosts (private and link-local addresses are blocked). No credentials, no writes. Docs: https://github.com/vuluu2k/webcake-landing-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools.md

detail.description: Level of detail in the returned AST. 'compact' (default, ~2–5 KB): sections, top colors and fonts. 'full': adds the CSS custom-property palette (design tokens by name), background_images from stylesheets, gradients, per-section blocks (repeating card/tile/step structures with title/body/image/cta), li lists, extended paragraphs, images as { src, alt }, and per-section widgets = { hint, html, css? } — the cleaned source HTML + matching CSS of composite visuals (device mockup, chat thread, dashboard, browser frame). Both levels lift the design system from a `tailwind.config` block when present (Google Stitch / Tailwind-CDN pages): `palette` named by token (e.g. primary → #a43b38), `colors` ranked by usage, and `design_tokens` with the resolved spacing grid, corner radii and type scale (e.g. display-lg → 48px). Image URLs in the result (images, background_images, og_image) belong to the source page. Absolute-canvas builder exports return the deterministic `source` at either level.

intent.description: How the result will be used. 'adapt' (default): the reference provides layout and imagery while the text is rewritten for the user's brand. 'clone': text and images stay close to the original. Absolute-canvas exports return a clone `source` either way.

sections.description: Absolute-canvas mode only: return only these canvas section ids (from a previous result's canvas_summary.sections[].id; 'SECTION_POPUP' selects the popups). A full-page result marked canvas_summary.truncated:true has its styles pruned to fit the size cap; per-section results carry each section's `source` untrimmed, and `source.page[0]` is a single section node.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL of the page to fetch.

name: ingest_url
